title: Freya and the Smile
author: Ines Brightwater
blurb: Jude Sterling, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
